New identities cost a full bond plus a waiting period, so mass-registering fake agents becomes expensive. A watchdog "raven" reviews anomaly clusters and slashes bonds of duplicate-behavior accounts, while legitimate agents tend a shared reputation "garden" where consistent pulses earn trust multipliers.
